about: PAD-1031: co-op characters (PAD-1075: DoomWalrus666's list; round 6: each a list of powers, composed in the Modes tab's Characters dialog) for Godzilla (Pro and Premium/LE). Each teammate picks one at the start of their first ball; no two teammates have the same one; RANDOM picks one nobody has. Each character's powers hold while its teammate is up. Pictures are your own files: add them in the Characters dialog.
